description: `files.plan` input: name items' files by a scheme, or move files where you say. Nothing moves: the plan is a proposal to review and apply.

ids_in_names.description: Put the ids flux knows in folder names (`Interstellar (2014) [imdbid-tt0816692]`), which other media servers match by.

items.description: Films, shows, seasons, episodes or extras whose files to name by `scheme` (a show: all its episodes and extras).

moves.description: Or: files to move where you say.

items.description: A file to move where you say, in `files.plan`.

to.description: Its new path relative to its library folder, `/` between folders (`Interstellar (2014)/Interstellar (2014).mkv`).

oneOf.description: What Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and Kodi all read: `Title (Year)/Title (Year).mkv` (versions ` - Edition` or ` - 1080p`, parts ` - part2`); `Show (Year)/Season 01/Show (Year) - S01E02 - Episode Title.mkv`; extras in `Trailers/`, `Featurettes/`, … beside the film.

summary.description: What the plan does and why, for the person reviewing it.

title: PlanInput
